head.title: Tob & Matarax
head.premise: Tob Gobble and Matarax team up to subversively topple Dalton Trask's corporate empire, but things don't go as planned.

accounts.name: Matarax
accounts.description: The cosmic spider weaves chains of prayers into a web connecting everything beyond this world.

accounts.name: Tunnel of Matarax
accounts.description: The People of Anthuor travel between worlds through this passage, also interpreted as a connection between the poles of Mars and Earth.

accounts.name: Tunnel of Matarax
accounts.description: The People of Anthuor traverse Hypogeic space through this passage while fleeing the destruction of their former world.
The subterranean route through which the Atlantean women descended, reached via the UFO caves in Antarctica.
accounts.evidence: the Tunnel of Matarax, from which they had descended through the UFO caves in Antarctica .

accounts.name: Dalton Trask
accounts.description: A secret asteroid-mining magnate is accused of directing the renegade AIs and inheriting control of a covert space program.

accounts.name: Dalton Trask
accounts.description: The architect of subscription government attempts to control existence through algorithms amid contradictory histories and failing reality.

accounts.name: Dalton Trask
accounts.description: A space-mining magnate returns from exile and uses satellites and a buried quantum computer to seize earthly power.

accounts.name: Dalton Trask
accounts.description: The magnate who develops lethal mind uploading later experiences unstable uploaded realities while pursuing planetary power.

accounts.name: Dalton Trask
accounts.description: The satellite magnate's rivalry with the Eastern Alliance drives the war that destroys orbital infrastructure.

accounts.name: Dalton Trask
accounts.description: The narrator repeatedly encounters Trask's image and describes an unstable identification with him.

accounts.name: Dalton Trask
accounts.description: Trask collapses when the spirit departs at the end of Kal's encounter in the Place of Decay.
Founder-figure of the Martian Technocracy's ruling line and sole sovereign administrator of Mars, to whom all Technocracy profits flow.

accounts.name: Tob Gobble
accounts.description: The Quatrian potato trickster appears across cultures and eras, with conflicting accounts of his origins and death.

accounts.name: Tob Gobble
accounts.description: The trickster remains a beloved figure despite his mischievous behavior.

accounts.name: Tob Gobble
accounts.description: Peculiar small companion who befriends Benda and tells the tale of his people.
accounts.evidence: Chapter 2: The Tale of Tob’s People 2 THE TALE OF TOB’S PEOPLE B enda and Tob Gobble sat down in the grove so that Tob could tell his tale.

accounts.name: Tob Gobble

accounts.evidence: Tob Gobble felt the thrill of the open road ahead
